title: Normalized integral compact-support compositor component
statement: For one integral constructible input, the proper/open construction and refinement normalization specify a unique isomorphism between the nested and composite compact-support values.

proof.text: Choose a compatible compactification tower and form the normalized completed proper/open map. Finite-level invertibility and complete reduction realization make its transported component an isomorphism. Common refinement and equalizer coherence prove its normalization for every tower; the normalized adjunction equation proves uniqueness componentwise.
